preview.transform: panel RGB to linear BT.709, shared division by reference, clip, sRGB OETF
preview.limitation: SDR preview clipping can hide wide-gamut differences; raw XYZ and metrics remain authoritative.

stimuli.skin_foliage: Illustrative BT.709-linear colors converted to BT.2020; not measured reflectances.

effective_settings.name: generic_va_fald_miniled
effective_settings.description: Placeholder VA mini-LED FALD set. Contrast is high on axis and falls off quickly with angle. Zone grid and PSF are round numbers, not a zone map from a shipping set.

effective_settings.name: generic_ips_edge
effective_settings.description: Placeholder edge-lit IPS set. Native contrast is lower than VA, viewing angle is wider, and the backlight is a single row of segments whose light is spread by a wide PSF. Each segment drives a full-height column before the blur; that is a stand-in, not a light-guide simulation.

effective_settings.name: generic_woled
effective_settings.description: Placeholder WOLED. Emission is per pixel (no zone grid). The WRGB mosaic is energy-preserving when box-filtered, so it does not change a flat color. ABL pulls the allowed peak down toward the full-field figure as APL rises. Spectral white-subpixel mixing beyond that mosaic is not modeled.

effective_settings.name: generic_qdoled
effective_settings.description: Placeholder QD-OLED. The triangular subpixel buffer is a geometric stand-in that box-filters back to the source color. A little per-pixel PSF stands in for optical crosstalk. Quantum-dot spectra and a real gamut matrix are not modeled; color_matrix stays identity.
